Pop-ups we have built.

Three of the pop-ups on J Mansfield’s current site, shown with their own photographs.

Jo Malone Christmas PopUp at Selfridges

A white boarded cabin dressed as a gift, with a black bow on the roof, oversized gold stars outside and a ceiling of hanging stars inside.

The Marshmallowist Pop-Up at Canary Wharf

Two timber stalls on the Canary Wharf plaza: a fire stall with a striped front and a lit white hut for the marshmallows.

“Jamie and his team were brilliant! They turned up early - and did a fantastic job (even when given ridiculous event break down time slots!) I genuinely can’t recommend them highly enough and I will definitely be using their services in the future.”

Oonagh Simms, The Marshmallowist

Charli Cohen x Pokemon PopUp at Selfridges

Printed walls in a run of freestanding panels, with clothing hung in clear domes and a plywood information stand.

How we work.

  1. 1

  4. 4
